title: The Stabat Mater of Rossini
html_source:
Gioacchino Rossini (1792-1868) was an Italian composer known mainly for his operas; the Stabat Mater (1832, revised 1841) one of his more famous non-operatic works.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_g70u9e-gv4

Molly did sing this at church. The reader does not know if this indicates she is a practising Catholic or not. We only see her through the lens of Bloom’s internal monologue.
